test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The marked price of a bed sheet was Rs. 750. A man bought the bed sheet for Rs. 560. after getting two successive discounts of which the first was 16%. How much was the second discount?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price = Rs. 560

MRP = Rs. 750

First discount(D₁) = 16%

Second discount(D₂) = ?

**Formula used:**

CP = MRPtimes{(100-D₁)over100} times {(100-D₂)over100}

D% = (D×100)over MRP

**Calculation:**

Let the second discount be D₂%

⇒ 560 = 750times{(100-16)over100} times {(100-D₂)over100} 

⇒ 560 = 750times{84over100} times {(100-D₂)over100}

⇒ 22,400 = 25,200 – 252D₂&l
